# Lepidus Design System

> Lepidus is Lepide's enterprise design system: design tokens generated from
> Figma (DTCG → CSS variables), three themes (light / dark / high-contrast),
> 38 React components, and a plain-CSS distribution (@lepidus/css) for
> HTML/CSS/JS apps. This file is for AI assistants generating Lepide UI.

## Rules for generated code

- Default to **plain HTML with `lp-` classes** (Lepide product teams ship
  HTML/CSS/JS). Use `@lepidus/react` components only when the project already
  uses React.
- **Never hardcode colors, radii, spacing or font sizes.** Use the token CSS
  variables: `var(--component-*)` first, `var(--color-*)` / `var(--space-*)` /
  `var(--radius-*)` semantics otherwise.
- Theming: set `data-theme="light" | "dark" | "hc"` on `<html>`. Never write
  per-theme color values by hand — the variables resolve per theme.
- Font is Open Sans (`var(--font-family-primary)`). Buttons and inputs are
  pill-shaped (high radius) — this comes from tokens, do not override.
- Keep accessibility patterns from the documented markup: `:focus-visible`
  outlines, `role="switch"` + `aria-checked` for toggles, `aria-invalid` +
  described-by for input errors, `aria-current="page"` in breadcrumbs.

## Plain-CSS usage

Link one stylesheet (from `packages/css/dist/` in the repo):

    <link rel="stylesheet" href="lepidus.css" />

Class naming is BEM with an `lp-` prefix: block `lp-button`, modifier
`lp-button--primary`, element `lp-button__icon-left`.

Components available as plain CSS (copy-paste markup on the
"Foundations → HTML & CSS" docs page of this site):

- Button — `lp-button` + `--primary|--secondary|--danger|--white`,
  sizes `--sm|--md|--lg`, `--full-width`, icon slots `__icon-left/right`
- Badge — `lp-badge` + `--default|--success|--warning|--error|--neutral`,
  optional `__dot`
- Tag — `lp-tag` + same status modifiers + `--disabled`, `__label`, `__remove`
- Card — `lp-card` + `--elevated|--borderless`; `__header`, `__title`,
  `__actions`, `__body`, `__footer`
- Input — `lp-input` wrapper (+`--full-width`); `__row` (+`--label-top|--label-left`),
  `__label`, `__field` (+`--error|--disabled`), `__input`, `__icon-left/right`,
  `__message` (+`--error|--indent`)
- Toggle — `lp-toggle` (+`--on`) with `__thumb`; `<button role="switch">`
- Checkbox — `lp-checkbox` (+`--disabled`); `__control`, `__input` (real
  checkbox), `__box` (+`--error`), `__check`, `__dash`, `__label`
- Breadcrumb — `lp-breadcrumb`; `__list`, `__item`, `__link`, `__separator`,
  `__current`
- Table — `lp-table` wrapper; `__table`, `__th`, `__header-inner`,
  `__header-label`, `__sort-button`, `__sort-arrow` (+`--active|--desc`),
  `__filter-cell/field/input`, `__td`, `__cell-inner`, `__cell-text`,
  `__row--selected`, `__checkbox`
- Alert panel — `lp-alert-panel`; `__icon`, `__headline`, `__title`,
  `__summary`, `__details`, `__action`, `__footnote`
- Link — `lp-link` + `--inline|--standalone|--disabled`; `__icon`,
  `__external-icon`, `__visually-hidden`
- Avatar — `lp-avatar` + sizes `--sm|--md|--lg|--xl`, shapes `--circle|--square`,
  fallback fills `--series1`…`--series6`, `--overflow`; `__image`, `__fallback`,
  `__status` (+`--online|--away|--offline`); groups: `lp-avatar-group` +
  `lp-avatar-group__item`
- Skeleton — `lp-skeleton` + `--text|--circle|--rect`; multi-line:
  `lp-skeleton-paragraph` + `lp-skeleton-paragraph__last-line`
- Spinner — `lp-spinner` + `--sm|--md|--lg`; `__svg`, `__track`, `__arc`,
  `__visually-hidden` (SVG: viewBox 0 0 24 24, circles cx/cy 12 r 10
  stroke-width 3; arc adds stroke-dasharray "28 72", path-length 100)
- Message — `lp-message` + `--info|--success|--warning|--error`; `__icon`,
  `__content`, `__text`, `__title`, `__body`, `__actions`, `__close`
- Empty state — `lp-empty-state`; `__illustration`, `__message`, `__action`

## Interactive components (include lepidus.js)

`<script src="lepidus.js"></script>` — 4 KB vanilla helper, auto-initializes:

- Tabs — `lp-tabs` with `data-lp-tabs` + `role="tablist"`; buttons
  `lp-tabs__tab` (+`--active`) with `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`,
  `aria-controls` pointing at `role="tabpanel"` elements (inactive panels get
  `hidden`). Keyboard: arrows/Home/End, roving tabindex — provided by the JS.
- Modal — backdrop `lp-modal` (`hidden` when closed) containing
  `lp-modal__shell` (+`--sm|--md|--lg|--inline`) with `role="dialog"`,
  `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby`; `__header` (+`--center|--left`), `__title`,
  `__body`, `__fields` + `__field-label`, `__footer`. Open with
  `data-lp-modal-open="<id>"`, close with `data-lp-modal-close` / Escape /
  backdrop click; focus is trapped and restored; `data-lp-autofocus` picks the
  initial focus. JS API: `Lepidus.openModal(id)`, `Lepidus.closeModal()`.

Components not yet converted to plain CSS (use the React package or wait):
Accordion, ActionItem, Calendar, Charts, Dropdown, Filter, FolderTree,
Pagination, Progress, Radio, Scrollbar, SettingsPanel, Sidebar, Stepper,
Steps, TextField, Textarea, TimePicker, Toast, Tooltip.

## React usage

    import { Button } from '@lepidus/react';
    // load @lepidus/tokens css, then @lepidus/react/style.css first
    <Button variant="primary" size="md">Save</Button>

## Key token names

- Buttons: `--component-button-{primary|secondary|danger|white}-{fill|stroke|text}`,
  hover variants `-hover-fill`
- Status pairs: `--component-status-{success|warning|error|na}-{bg|text}`
- Inputs: `--component-input-{bg|border|text|placeholder|label|radius}`,
  focus `-bg-focus|-border-focus`
- Surfaces: `--color-background-{page|surface|raised|subtle|cards}`
- Text: `--color-text-{primary|secondary|disabled|inverse|brand|danger}`
- Focus ring: `--color-focus-ring`; brand border: `--color-border-brand`
